title: 掌扶低岩包
description: 水粉表现板壁上轻扶宽岩包、由脚承重的平衡姿态。

art_direction.medium: fine pen and transparent watercolor on warm paper
art_direction.scene: Create an original gouache illustration of a fictional clothed adult lightly pressing a palm against a broad volume on a low slab wall. Both shoes stand on clear positive footholds, the supporting leg bears the weight, and the other hand reaches toward a comfortable rounded edge. The palm is a gentle balance contact, not a dramatic push or suspended body position. Use an oblique wide composition that includes the slab slope, whole adult, and uninterrupted crash mats. Paint cream wall planes, terracotta volumes, and sage green clothing with visible matte brushwork. Maintain plausible hands and foot contact. No writing, logos, jumping, high exposure, or crowded landing zone.
